No. No manual CSF tap. Absolutely not.
There was a finality in his tone not harsh, but rooted.This boy has come back from the dead. He has fought what very few could survive. A brain infection, damage, trauma… and he’s still here. You cannot take another chance. Not again.
I didn’t need convincing after that.
Something in his voice, in his presence, settled everything inside me.
He said he would give homeopathy medicines to reduce the fluid and relieve the headaches and I trusted him completely and so did my children
